function.description: Get confirmed field notices affecting a network device. Use this tool after resolving the device id when the user asks which field notices affect a specific device. In final answers, show only confirmed field notices and confirmed counts by default. Do not include potentialDeviceCount, potential field notice counts, or POTENTIALLY_VULNERABLE matches unless the user explicitly asks for potential field notices.
function.name: api_getFieldNoticesAffectingTheNetworkDevice

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

order.description: Whether ascending or descending order should be used to sort the response. Available values : asc, desc. Default value is asc.

sortBy.description: A property within the response to sort by.

type.description: Return field notices with this type. Available values : SOFTWARE, HARDWARE.

response.description: List of field notice match details

deviceCount.description: Number of confirmed devices which are vulnerable to this field notice.

firstPublishDate.description: Time at which the field notice was published

lastUpdatedDate.description: Time at which the field notice was last updated

matchConfidence.description: 'VULNERABLE' means the network device is confirmed vulnerable to the field notice. 'POTENTIALLY_VULNERABLE' means the network device is potentially vulnerable and requires additional manual verification. Do not include POTENTIALLY_VULNERABLE matches unless the user explicitly asks for potential field notices.

matchReason.description: If the MatchConfidence is POTENTIALLY_VULNERABLE, this gives more details such as what was matched and if additional manual verifications are needed.

potentialDeviceCount.description: Number of devices which are potentially vulnerable to this field notice. Do not include this value in final answers unless the user explicitly asks for potential field notices.

publicationUrl.description: Url for getting field notice details on cisco website

type.description: 'SOFTWARE' - field notice is for the network device software. 'HARDWARE' - field notice is for the network device hardware
